method.note: Two sub-tasks. (A) Slot re-measurement for the two servers now in build (image, bank-statement): single GET registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=<token>&limit=100, 20s timeout, one request per token, no pagination beyond the first page (task-specified bounded probe, same style as NAMING_R2). Count = servers.length on that page; flagged '100+' when the page was full and metadata.nextCursor was present. (B) Score the next three candidates after image/bank-statement from the R4 candidate list (kanban/todo, flashcards, quote/estimate, unit converter, markdown-to-html/pdf, csv cleaner, habit tracker, notes/journal, password generator, qr code), same fit formula as R1/R4 (score = demand/(1+supply); fit = score * pairs * local_value). These 9 candidates already have full registry/Smithery/npm/GitHub instrument readings in docs/INTEL.md (R1) and docs/INTEL_R4.md (R4) and the tokens have not moved since (no naming publish touched these words), so B reuses those measured fit scores rather than re-running the full instrument set a third time on unchanged inputs; this mirrors R4's own stated policy of carrying forward unchanged intents from R1 rather than re-measuring them.
